source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Push the existing sharps downward with a tool to create room before replacing the container.","B":"Transfer the contents into a larger sharps container so the original container can remain in service.","C":"Continue using the container until the opening is physically blocked, then close and replace it.","D":"Close and replace the sharps container at the designated fill line rather than allowing it to overfill."}}
source_row.rationale: OSHA requires sharps containers to be replaced routinely and not allowed to overfill. Containers must be closed immediately before removal or replacement, and reusable containers must not be manually opened or emptied in a way that exposes workers to percutaneous injury.
source_row.source_detail: §1910.1030(d)(4)(iii)(A)(2)(iii) sharps containers not allowed to overfill; §(A)(3)(i) close immediately before removal or replacement.
